world: a frozen snow kingdom with ancient stone ruins and mythical beasts
characters: Kaelen (19, lean scout, braided dark hair, intense amber eyes, hooded gray wolf-fur parka, leather arm braces, bone dagger at his hip); Sora (16, Kaelen's sister, silver hair in twin braids, bright green eyes, thick white wool tunic, faded turquoise scarf, brass relic compass); Frostfang (ancient six-horned frost drake, luminescent sapphire scales, feathered icy wings, scarred snout, towering size, glowing azure eyes).
title: The Beast of the Glacial Throne
summary: Kaelen races against a deadly curse to save his freezing sister Sora before the midnight bell tolls. Deep within ancient ruins, they discover that a mythical dragon is not the monster, but the guardian holding back eternal darkness.

world: towering mountains where a lone warrior protects a village from a giant beast
characters: Kaelen (28, male): rugged warrior, piercing gray eyes, scar over left eyebrow, dark hair in a short warrior bun, weathered fur-lined leather armor, wielding a broad runic iron sword. Mira (10, female): curious village girl, bright amber eyes, braided chestnut hair, oversized wool coat, holding a glowing blue geode relic. Torvak (ancient beast): colossal four-legged stone and ice behemoth, glowing azure fissures along basalt armor plates, four burning golden eyes, curved obsidian horns.
title: The Last Guardian of Stone
summary: When a lone warrior is ordered to slay a colossal mountain beast threatening his village, he discovers the monster is actually trying to reclaim its stolen heart. By defying his corrupt elders and restoring the titan's core, the warrior brings eternal warmth and an unbreakable bond between man and beast.
